bindings.note: Amazon keywords carry no metrics; search-term spend is the closest real figure.

bindings.unavailable: Meta does not report ACOS — use roas.
Google does not report ACOS — use roas.

bindings.note: MetricFlow roas spans ad_spend + orders so it groups by time only. platform_reported_roas is single-model and groups by campaign.
In an ad context total_sales means platform-reported conversion value, not Shopify revenue.
Meta pixel events (meta_insights.add_to_carts); rows for other platforms are empty.
Meta pixel events (meta_insights.checkouts_initiated); rows for other platforms are empty.

bindings.unavailable: Meta's link-click basis (inline_link_clicks) has no MetricFlow metric yet — MetricFlow clicks is the all-clicks basis. Define it in _metrics.yml first.
quality_score is ingested (fct_google_keywords.quality_score) but no MetricFlow metric exposes it yet. Google-only; never plain-average — weight by impressions.
mer = delivered revenue / total ad spend across every platform. No MetricFlow metric defines it yet — compute from net_revenue and total_ad_spend and always print the formula.
tacos = ad spend / total channel revenue (organic + ads). Seller jargon with no MetricFlow metric; needs the marketplace total-revenue join and must always be labelled calculated.

bindings.note: What the platform claims it drove — not money in the bank. delivered revenue is the Shopify figure.
Money that actually arrived (fct_orders, net of refunds) — the honest number to compare platform claims against.

acos_is_amazon_only.text: ACOS is an Amazon metric (spend / attributed sales). Other platforms do not report it. The number returned is Amazon only.

meta_google_only.text: CPM and CPC come from fct_ad_spend, which covers Meta and Google only. Amazon and Flipkart spend is not included.

reach_frequency_meta_only.text: Reach and frequency are Meta concepts, counted on unique people. Other platforms do not report them, reach cannot be summed across days or levels, and frequency is impressions / reach over the exact period asked for — never averaged from daily rows.

cross_platform_totals.text: Each platform counts sales for a different period after the click — Amazon 7 days, Google 30, Meta 7-click plus 1-view — and we do not record which. Spend, impressions and clicks add up safely. Conversions and revenue do not.

reported_not_delivered.text: This is what the platform claims it drove, not money received. Shopify order revenue is the delivered figure.

fanout_not_totalled.text: This came back as one result per platform because the same product has a different id on each channel (ASIN on Amazon, FSN on Flipkart). They cannot be added together or ranked as one list until a product crosswalk exists.

month_grain_only.text: This model only holds monthly rows. A daily or weekly answer cannot be produced from it.

deprecated_attribution.text: Built on the retired session-based attribution. Not maintained — do not use until it is repointed at platform-reported figures.

amazon_no_keys.text: Amazon primary keys are defined in the target schema and added by fixes/migrations/001. Until that migration has run in your environment, no Amazon table enforces uniqueness — a repeated sync double-counts silently. Once 001 is applied and the ingest uses ON CONFLICT, delete this caveat.

google_search_terms_range.text: This model's time dimension is last_seen, the end of a range rather than an event date. A date filter on it does not mean what it appears to mean.

approx_google_keywords.text: Google keyword metrics are the ad group's numbers split evenly across its keywords. Fine for ranking, not for exact per-keyword cost.

campaign_frequency.name: campaign_frequency

meta_placement_conversions.name: meta_placement_conversions

meta_placement_roas.name: meta_placement_roas

meta_placement_freq_x_impressions.name: meta_placement_freq_x_impressions
meta_placement_freq_x_impressions.label: Meta Placement Freq×Impr

meta_geo_conversions.name: meta_geo_conversions

meta_geo_revenue.name: meta_geo_revenue
meta_geo_revenue.label: Meta Geo Revenue

meta_geo_roas.name: meta_geo_roas
meta_geo_roas.label: Meta Geo ROAS
meta_geo_roas.description: Meta reported ROAS by geography = revenue / spend. Filter geo_level first.

meta_hourly_spend.name: meta_hourly_spend
meta_hourly_spend.label: Meta Hourly Spend
meta_hourly_spend.description: Meta ad spend by hour-of-day (advertiser time zone). Groupable by hour, campaign_name.

meta_hourly_conversions.name: meta_hourly_conversions
meta_hourly_conversions.label: Meta Hourly Conversions
meta_hourly_conversions.description: Meta platform-reported purchases by hour-of-day (directional signal).

meta_hourly_revenue.name: meta_hourly_revenue
meta_hourly_revenue.label: Meta Hourly Revenue
meta_hourly_revenue.description: Meta platform-reported purchase value by hour-of-day (directional signal).

meta_hourly_roas.name: meta_hourly_roas
meta_hourly_roas.label: Meta Hourly ROAS
meta_hourly_roas.description: Meta reported ROAS by hour-of-day = revenue / spend. Best-time-to-run analysis.

google_st_conversions.name: google_st_conversions

google_kw_spend.name: google_kw_spend
google_kw_spend.label: Google Keyword Spend (approx)

google_campaign_budget.name: google_campaign_budget

lifecycle_customers.name: lifecycle_customers
lifecycle_customers.label: Lifecycle Customers

lifecycle_ltv.name: lifecycle_ltv
lifecycle_ltv.label: Lifecycle LTV
lifecycle_ltv.description: Total lifetime revenue of customers in a lifecycle band — the revenue AT RISK in at_risk/overdue bands.

pde_units.name: pde_units
pde_units.label: Units by Discount Band
pde_units.description: Units sold per product at a discount-depth band. Group by product_discount_elasticity → product_title + discount_band to see if a SKU sells more when discounted (sensitive) or steady (insensitive) — #A5.

pde_orders.name: pde_orders
pde_orders.label: Orders by Discount Band
pde_orders.description: Orders per product at a discount-depth band (discount sensitivity).

pde_net_sales.name: pde_net_sales
pde_net_sales.label: Net Sales by Discount Band
pde_net_sales.description: Net sales per product at a discount-depth band.

meta_adset_reach.name: meta_adset_reach
meta_adset_reach.label: Meta Ad-set Reach
meta_adset_reach.description: Meta ad-set monthly reach. Group by meta_adset_saturation → adset_id + month. Reach FALLING while avg frequency RISES month-over-month = a saturated audience (#Q21).

meta_adset_avg_frequency.name: meta_adset_avg_frequency
meta_adset_avg_frequency.label: Meta Ad-set Avg Frequency
meta_adset_avg_frequency.description: Meta ad-set impressions-weighted average frequency per month = freq_x_impr / impressions. RISING month-over-month with flat/falling reach = saturation (#Q21).

meta_adset_freq_x_impr.name: meta_adset_freq_x_impr
meta_adset_freq_x_impr.label: Meta Ad-set Freq x Impr
meta_adset_freq_x_impr.description: Sum(frequency x impressions) at ad-set/month (internal — numerator of meta_adset_avg_frequency).

meta_adset_impressions.name: meta_adset_impressions
meta_adset_impressions.label: Meta Ad-set Impressions
meta_adset_impressions.description: Meta ad-set monthly impressions (denominator of avg frequency).

meta_creative_spend.name: meta_creative_spend
meta_creative_spend.label: Meta Creative Spend
meta_creative_spend.description: Meta creative (ad) spend. Group by meta_creatives → funnel_stage (prospecting/retargeting) + creative_name to compare which creatives work for cold prospecting vs retargeting (#Q36).

meta_creative_clicks.name: meta_creative_clicks
meta_creative_clicks.label: Meta Creative Clicks
meta_creative_clicks.description: Meta creative clicks (for CTR by funnel stage).

meta_creative_ctr.name: meta_creative_ctr
meta_creative_ctr.label: Meta Creative CTR
meta_creative_ctr.description: Meta creative CTR = clicks / impressions. Group by funnel_stage to compare prospecting vs retargeting creative efficiency (#Q36).

fk_campaign_spend.name: fk_campaign_spend
fk_campaign_spend.label: FK Campaign Spend
fk_campaign_spend.description: Flipkart PLA campaign spend. Group by flipkart_campaigns → campaign_name / campaign_status (LIVE/PAUSED/…) / campaign_type.

fk_campaign_count.name: fk_campaign_count
fk_campaign_count.label: FK Campaign Count
fk_campaign_count.description: Count of Flipkart campaigns. Group by campaign_status to see LIVE vs PAUSED vs DRAFT counts.

fk_campaign_roas.name: fk_campaign_roas
fk_campaign_roas.label: FK Campaign ROAS
fk_campaign_roas.description: Flipkart PLA campaign ROAS = revenue / spend. Group by campaign_name / campaign_status. The real efficiency metric for Flipkart campaigns.

amazon_spend.name: amazon_spend
amazon_spend.label: Amazon Spend
amazon_spend.description: Amazon Ads spend (cost). Group by amazon_campaigns → ad_product (SPONSORED_PRODUCTS/BRANDS/DISPLAY) / campaign_name / marketplace.

amazon_sales.name: amazon_sales
amazon_sales.label: Amazon Attributed Sales
amazon_sales.description: Amazon Ads ATTRIBUTED sales (SP=7-day window). Real conversion revenue — Amazon gives attribution, so this is trustworthy.

amazon_roas.name: amazon_roas
amazon_roas.label: Amazon ROAS
amazon_roas.description: Amazon ROAS = attributed sales / spend. REAL (Amazon-attributed, not platform-claimed). Group by ad_product to compare SP vs SB vs SD, or by campaign_name.

amazon_acos.name: amazon_acos
amazon_acos.label: Amazon ACOS

amazon_kw_count.name: amazon_kw_count

amazon_kw_avg_bid.name: amazon_kw_avg_bid
amazon_kw_avg_bid.label: Amazon Keyword Bid Total

amazon_st_spend.name: amazon_st_spend

amazon_st_roas.name: amazon_st_roas

amazon_tgt_count.name: amazon_tgt_count

amazon_tgt_bid_total.name: amazon_tgt_bid_total

amazon_prod_spend.name: amazon_prod_spend
